crossRefs.note: But when they persecute you in this city, flee into the next, for most certainly I tell you, you will not have gone…
Jesus, perceiving that, withdrew from there. Great multitudes followed him; and he healed them all,
In these days, he went out to the mountain to pray, and he continued all night in prayer to God.
They sought again to seize him, and he went out of their hand.
So from that day forward they took counsel that they might put him to death.
Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews, but departed from there into the country near the wilderness, to…
When some of both the Gentiles and the Jews, with their rulers, made a violent attempt to mistreat and stone them,
they became aware of it and fled to the cities of Lycaonia, Lystra, Derbe, and the surrounding region.
The brothers immediately sent Paul and Silas away by night to Beroea. When they arrived, they went into the Jewish…
Then the brothers immediately sent out Paul to go as far as to the sea, and Silas and Timothy still stayed there.
Great multitudes from Galilee, Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea and from beyond the Jordan followed him.
He came down with them, and stood on a level place, with a crowd of his disciples, and a great number of the people…
He went into their synagogues throughout all Galilee, preaching and casting out demons.
They set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath…
Out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer…
But they insisted, saying, “He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee even to this…
Others said, “This is the Christ.” But some said, “What, does the Christ come out of Galilee?
They answered him, “Are you also from Galilee? Search, and see that no prophet has arisen out of Galilee.”
